text: D1 owner-side verification is explicitly unimplemented (receipt Deferred item8). Read-only design consultation confirms raw payloads are insufficient to reconstruct CorpusDigest soundly: condition encoding lacks lags and coverage inputs; NativeTrialFit encoding omits voxelStatus consumed by TrialNativeScoring; production ScoreFeed/CoverageObs assembly is absent. Need producer-side canonical scorer contributions bound to exact attempts plus a post-confirmation verifier; payload-hash comparison alone is insufficient. Python custody paths are unreserved, but the required Scala producer seam overlaps active S7 ownership. Coordinate via Fray168/171 before acceptance.
